data.name: Aashiq
data.gender_notes: Aashiq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is passionate and devoted to Allah or to a beloved one. In Islamic tradition, Aashiq denotes a person who is deeply in love with Allah and strives to please Him. The name Aashiq carries the meaning “Lover of the Beloved” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aashiq usually hope their child will grow to embody lover of the beloved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion, love, and a deep connection with Allah.
data.etymology: Aashiq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lover of the Beloved.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aashiq total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: أَشِق
in_arabic.long_meaning: أَشِقُ: مصدر من الأَشِيقَة، والفعل يُشَيقُ، وَهُوَ المشتاق إلى الشَيء، وَالْمُتَّابع، وَالْمُطلِع: المَطلوعُ للَيلِ، وَالمَطلوعُ إلى الوَرى. وَبِهَذا الصِفَةِ يُعرَفُ الإيمانُ، وَيَستَصفيهِ المُؤمِنُ، وَيَطلُعُ بِهِ المَطلوعُ. وَقالَ تعالى: {وَإِنَّهُ لَتَفَripperِقُ الشَوقُ إِلى اللَهِ} [الرحمن: 22].

in_urdu.name: اشیق
in_urdu.long_meaning: اشیق: مصدر اشیقہ، جس کا معنی ہے مَشتیاق، مُتَّبع، مُطلع۔ ہمہ جہت مسٹاق ہونے والا کہ جو کسی بھی طرف مشغول ہو۔ اور بھی اس کا مطلب ہے، جو کسی کو پیار کرتا ہے۔ ایماندار، ایمان کی پیروی کرنے والا۔ اللہ کے لئے ہمیشہ متوجہ رہنے والا۔ اللہ سے محبت کا ایک بڑا شوق رکھنے والا۔

in_english.name: Aashiq
in_english.meaning: Aashiq: passionate, devoted, attentive, devoted to Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Aashiq is an Arabic name that means passionate, devoted, attentive, and devoted to Allah. The name Aashiq is derived from the Arabic root Ashyaq, which means to be attracted or drawn to something. In Islamic tradition, an Aashiq is one who is deeply in love with Allah and is devoted to His service. An Aashiq is someone who is always mindful of Allah and strives to please Him in every aspect of life. The name Aashiq is often associated with qualities such as loyalty, dedication, and selflessness. In modern times, the name Aashiq has become popular in many Muslim cultures as a symbol of devotion and love for Allah.
